ro.tagline: Apartamente cu wellness, la poalele Bucegilor.
ro.intro: Green Future Sinaia este un complex rezidential modern in inima statiunii, cu apartamente luminoase, piscina interioara, sauna si vedere la munte. Rezervi direct de la proprietari, fara comision de intermediar.
ro.about_title: Un loc nou de evadare in Sinaia
ro.about_p1: Green Future Sinaia este un complex rezidential modern pe Str. Walter Maracineanu nr. 20, la cativa pasi de centrul statiunii si de partii. Apartamentele sunt luminoase, cu balcoane orientate spre munte.
ro.about_p2: Ce face diferenta: oaspetii au acces la o zona de wellness cu vedere la munte - piscina interioara incalzita, jacuzzi, sauna finlandeza si sala de fitness. Perfect dupa o zi pe partie sau pe traseele Bucegilor.

en.tagline: Apartments with wellness, at the foot of the Bucegi mountains.
en.intro: Green Future Sinaia is a modern residential complex in the heart of the resort, with bright apartments, an indoor pool, sauna and mountain views. Book directly from the owners, with no middleman commission.
en.about_title: A new place to escape in Sinaia
en.about_p1: Green Future Sinaia is a modern residential complex on Walter Maracineanu St. no. 20, steps from the resort centre and the ski slopes. The apartments are bright, with balconies facing the mountains.
en.about_p2: What sets it apart: guests have access to a wellness area with a mountain view - a heated indoor pool, jacuzzi, Finnish sauna and a gym. Perfect after a day on the slopes or on the Bucegi trails.
en.sinaia_title: Sinaia - The Pearl of the Carpathians

ro.title: Sauna finlandeza
ro.note: caldura dupa o zi pe munte

en.title: Finnish sauna
en.note: warmth after a day on the mountain

ro.name: Castelul Peles
ro.desc: Prima resedinta regala a Romaniei - capodopera neo-renascentista cu peste 160 de camere, gradini in terase si o colectie de arta impresionanta.

en.name: Peles Castle
en.desc: Romania's first royal residence - a neo-Renaissance masterpiece with over 160 rooms, terraced gardens and an impressive art collection.

ro.name: Castelul Pelisor
ro.desc: Resedinta de vara a Reginei Maria, in delicatul stil Art Nouveau, cu celebrul Dormitor de Aur - mai intim si mai romantic decat Pelesul.

en.name: Pelisor Castle
en.desc: Queen Marie's summer residence in delicate Art Nouveau style, home to the famous Golden Room - more intimate and romantic than Peles.

ro.name: Manastirea Sinaia
ro.desc: Ctitorita in 1695, manastirea care a dat numele orasului - liniste, fresce vechi si prima vatra monahala din Valea Prahovei.

en.name: Sinaia Monastery
en.desc: Founded in 1695, the monastery that gave the town its name - peace, old frescoes and the first monastic settlement in the Prahova Valley.

ro.name: Muntii Bucegi
ro.desc: Telecabina urca la peste 2000 m, spre platoul Bucegi - trasee spectaculoase, aer curat si priveliste asupra intregii Vai a Prahovei.

en.name: Bucegi Mountains
en.desc: The cable car climbs above 2000 m to the Bucegi plateau - spectacular trails, fresh air and views over the whole Prahova Valley.

ro.name: Sfinxul din Bucegi
ro.desc: Megalit natural de aproape 8 metri, sculptat de vant si vreme - unul dintre cele mai fotografiate monumente ale Carpatilor, langa Babele.

en.name: The Bucegi Sphinx
en.desc: A nearly 8-metre natural megalith carved by wind and weather - one of the most photographed monuments in the Carpathians, next to Babele.

ro.name: Orasul Sinaia
ro.desc: Perla Carpatilor - cazinoul istoric, parcul Dimitrie Ghica, cafenele cochete si hoteluri de epoca, la poalele Bucegilor.

en.name: Sinaia town
en.desc: The Pearl of the Carpathians - the historic casino, Dimitrie Ghica Park, charming cafes and vintage hotels at the foot of the Bucegi.
